bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_slab_port_leaf u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_slab_port_leaf.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_me_spine_h_w12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_arith.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_matvec.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fpu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv rtl/physical/bb/ot_qwen_slab_pg_lanes_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_port_leaf/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_port_leaf/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_port_leaf --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_slab_port_leaf --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_slab_pg_lanes/views/ot_qwen_slab_pg_lanes > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: q15 port-tiles: new leaf. Each TP8 slab result port (group scale merge + ot_qwen_me_spport_w12 HARD_MUL, 10,455 sinks on ck_group<g>) was inline in qfd_slab_result_half inside the 2.46 mm port_tiles parent; now its own hardened cluster on its die clock entry with the four CLOSED slab_pg_lanes children on ck_mul entries (structure-only, hierarchy-equivalence bench fc0e16f69). pl3: lanes in one row with clock pins 22.7 um from scalar S-face entry pins ck_mul0-3 (pl2 gate: a 4-bit ck_mul bus pin far from the upper-row lanes was buffered by CTS repair_clock_nets -> OT_ENTRIES no direct port). pl4: pl3 CTS gate measured in->reg -567.8 ps (pt_id strap now a port: the 16-row (q0+g)*ots multiply and qg frame no longer constant-fold) and ck insertion 471.8/spread 132.8 on the 414.7-um row; fix = 5-bit strap captured at a pin flop + QOTS_SMALL exact decomposition (5 partial products) + compact 2x2 lanes (upper row R180, scalar ck_mul2/3 entries on N at their clock pins), util ~0.54.
